category_title: Quiet students with ambiguous comprehension during independent work
scenario_title: Distraction and disengagement during self-paced online learning
minimal_context: The student is working independently on a computer-based assignment using the Novanet online instructional program.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the Novanet online instructional program and continue your self-paced lesson on the computer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares blankly at the monitor) This program is boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next on the screen?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I do not seem to learn from the online lessons.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to read through the material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts their head on the desk, gets distracted, and begins to text on their cell phone instead of looking at the assignment.)
